summary: Frontend-only validation of the SIRIUS DISPLAY toolbar fix on the public URL. The first-run setup, highlighted Monitor + DISPLAY button, manual open/close toggles, panel close control, active cyan state, and command-triggered automatic MESSAGE display all passed. The button also remained fully visible at 1366x768. One pre-existing startup timing issue was reproduced: the 100% boot overlay can remain open beyond 7 seconds while waiting for speech completion, although clicking it skips successfully.

ui_bugs.issue: After first-run setup, the boot overlay was still blocking the HUD 7.28 seconds later despite showing 100%; it can be skipped by clicking.

action_items: Decouple BootScreen dismissal from speech completion, or shorten the speech safety timeout, if the intended startup duration is approximately 5 seconds.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 3,482 lines and App.css is 2,890 lines, far above the 700-line maintainability threshold; extract the DISPLAY/toolbar, command routing, boot, and related styles into focused modules.
BootScreen waits for both loaded and speechDone; when speech synthesis does not emit onend, the 16-second safety timer keeps a completed 100% overlay on screen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested SIRIUS DISPLAY flows; 1 unrelated low-priority boot timing issue

seed_data_creation: Created localStorage demo profile with first name 'Testeur'; no backend seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested at 1920x1080 and 1366x768. Clear localStorage to reproduce setup. Core assertions passed: sirius-display-btn contains one lucide Monitor SVG and visible DISPLAY label; inactive width ~98.6px; manual panel badge EN ATTENTE; class 'on' and settled styles background rgb(34,211,238), foreground rgb(3,18,30); second click and sirius-display-close both close; command 'présente-toi en une phrase' auto-opens sirius-display-message with MESSAGE badge. Wait about 1 second after click before asserting transitioned foreground color. Repeated ws://localhost:8765 connection failures remain console-only demo-mode noise.
rca_of_the_issue: BootScreen auto-closes only when both visual loading and speechDone are true. speechDone depends on the speech callback and otherwise uses a 16-second safety timeout, so the progress reaches 100% around 4.8 seconds but the overlay may continue blocking the HUD. Reproduction: clear localStorage, submit setup as Testeur, wait 7 seconds without clicking; boot-screen remains at 100%.
